Questions clinics actually ask.

Clinicos is the clinic operating system behind Doctors My Agency: appointments, patients, waiting room, clinical visits, WhatsApp, AI receptionist and operations — for one clinic’s private data. It is not a public doctor directory.

Front desk (bookings, inbox, leads), clinical visits (waiting → called → consult → vitals → prescription → complete), and operations (staff, rooms, leave, inventory and laboratory orders when you use them).

Yes. Receptionist, nurse, assistant and manager log in on the staff door. Owner-only tools (WhatsApp connection, AI publish, SaaS billing, settings) stay owner-only on the server.

Yes. Locations are stored on the clinic roster. Appointments still book against working hours; rooms are optional physical spaces, not invented occupancy.

Each visit is tied to an appointment. The chart uses a single clinical contract: patient, appointment, vitals, diagnoses, clinical note, prescriptions and follow-up. CALLED is a first-class queue state.

Yes, on the visit chart. Clinicos does not send prescriptions to a pharmacy network unless a real integration exists.

Yes, when the clinic connects a WhatsApp Business account. Until then the inbox shows that WhatsApp is not configured — it will not pretend to be connected.

The receptionist can answer from clinic knowledge and live calendar availability, then pass the conversation to staff. It does not diagnose patients or replace clinicians.

Each clinic’s patients, messages and visits stay on that clinic’s account. There is no public marketplace of doctors or patients. See Privacy and Security for policy detail.

Stripe invoices are for the software subscription. Visit fees and patient invoices are clinic records. They are not the same ledger.
